author: Anthony Vaughn
subject: Account planning - CPM Precision IT
body:
Attendees: Megan Robertson (Dir IT), Tyler Katz (IT Mgr), Grant Wilson (Desktop Support); Orvane: Anthony Vaughn, Thomas Herrera (SA), Hiro Gray (TAM)

- ~2,500 named users across Seattle HQ + 4 fab plants. Plant floor uses shared Cadence SFF/Micro at stations; office staff on Aster 5/7.
- Windows 10 20H2 standard image, SCCM, no zero-touch. Imaging done at HQ and shipped to plants - 2-3 days per device.
- Infra: vSphere 6.7 on aging hosts, Oracle Cloud for ERP. Backup = tape + scripts. Megan knows it's a risk.
- FY22 priority from the CISO is zero-trust; PC refresh not funded until FY23.
- Megan wants a predictable refresh cycle (4 yrs) but finance keeps deferring.

Actions: Thomas - zero-touch provisioning overview (Autopilot-style via Orvane Manage); Hiro - warranty report on fleet; Anthony - check FY23 refresh budget timing with Megan.

author: Anthony Vaughn
subject: Office laptop wave 1 booked
body: Booked SO-30182527 ($166,866, PO 250027) - Aster 5 13 G2 for engineering + finance. First wave of the refresh Megan has been asking for (January's SO-30182477 was mostly infra; Brooke's April Vault order never got a PO and is likely to cancel). Next wave (plants) pushed to FY24 - budget.

author: Thanh Gutierrez
subject: Infra gets money, clients don't
body: Seo-yeon's Strata order SO-30182711 ($127,072, PO 543623) booked yesterday - infra keeps getting money. No client devices opp open at all; Megan says client refresh is frozen until the FY25 budget. Win11 at ~25%. Plant floor still on Cadence 3 Micro G3 that won't take Win11 without a swap.

author: Madison Perez
subject: Takeover notes - CPM Precision
body:
AO as of 2/1. Thanh's notes are thin. No open opps at all when I took over. Megan says budget is tight; FY25 client wave is a maybe.
Fleet: ~2,500 seats. Win11 ~25%. Big chunk of Aster 5 13 G2 (~150) and Cadence 3 Micro G3 / Cadence 7 Micro G3 aging out of warranty in FY26.
Infra: vSphere 6.7 still (!), tape backup. Atlas hosts from SO-30182657 (June 2023 - still shows PO "to follow" on our side).
Contacts: Megan Robertson (Dir IT) main. Susan Jackson (Dir EUC) owns PC refresh now. Susan Hughes is on some old distribution lists - she's Facilities, not IT.

author: Nathan Thompson
subject: Win11 readiness + Forge for CAM
body:
Susan Jackson (Dir EUC).
- Win11 stalled at ~25%. Blockers: ~280 devices below Win11 CPU baseline (Aster 5 13 G2, Cadence 3 Micro G3 and Cadence 7 Micro G3 at plants with old BIOS), plus CAM software certification.
- Madison's Aster 5 x94 (0065f00004demfLAAQ, $182,185) in July was the whole FY25 client budget - engineering only.
- CAM team (~60 users on mid-range 12GB GPU workstations) wants a bigger GPU for nesting/simulation. Forge with 24GB+ would do it.
- No client budget in FY25 beyond break/fix. She's trying to get Win11 refresh funded for FY26 before Win10 end of support (Oct 2025).
Will send Win11-eligibility report by serial from Insight.

author: Monica Howard
subject: Windows 10 end of support - trade-in offer
body:
Hi Tyler,

With Windows 10 support ending in October, wanted to share our trade-in program: we give a per-device credit (based on model and condition) toward Win11-ready Aster / Cadence, and Orvane handles data wipe + certificate of destruction. For CPM's ~280 non-eligible devices it can cover a meaningful part of the refresh.

Happy to walk through numbers with you and Susan.

Thanks,
Monica Howard
Inside Account Executive | Orvane Technologies

> Your message to tyler.katz@cpmprecision.com couldn't be delivered.

author: Darren Park
subject: DP loss
body: Lost 0065f00004devWGAAY ($211,866). They bought one Vault in October (SO-30182802, $223,379) but won't fund the second - plants stay on tape + scripts another year. Nathan Morales was in favor, finance said no after the November earnings miss. Will come back with a smaller Vault scope.

author: Madison Perez
subject: Edge / AI pilot + Northbridge acquisition briefing
body:
Attendees: Krista Hughes (CTO), Erin Reed (Dir Infra), Bryce Walker (VP Digital Transformation); Orvane: Madison Perez, Ananya Ramirez, Min-jun Chavez

Edge / IoT
- Outpost for plant-floor machine monitoring: Krista wants 6 to start (quote out), then 2 per site at the acquired locations.
- AI pilot: vision QA on welds. Needs a central GPU server (Atlas AI class) for training, inference on the Outposts, data back to Oracle Cloud.

Acquisition
- Krista: CPM closed the Northbridge Data Systems acquisition last week (3/3). Adds ~1,700 people and three sites. Seat count goes from ~2,600 to ~4,300 (+65%).
- Acquired company IT: Win10 on mixed, mostly older devices; their own AD/tenant; no MDM. Integration target 12 months.
- Erin: datacenter consolidation of acquired sites into Seattle - will need hosts and storage.

Note: Krista did not mention client budget for the acquired users. Need to ask.
Actions: Ananya - Atlas AI sizing for the pilot; Min-jun - consolidation sizing; Madison - set EUC meeting with Susan Jackson.

author: Madison Perez
subject: Only client order this FY
body: Booked SO-30182864 ($119,974, PO 961698) - exec + sales laptops, incl. Northbridge leadership. That's the only client purchase planned this FY - a few dozen devices for ~1,700 new people.

author: Nathan Thompson
subject: EUC post-acquisition planning
body:
Attendees: Susan Jackson (Dir EUC), Derek Aguilar (Desktop Support Mgr), Michelle Carter (Desktop Eng); Orvane: Nathan Thompson, Monica Howard, Brooke Gutierrez (Financial Services), Hiro Gray

Numbers (Susan's)
- Users: ~4,300 after acquisition, was ~2,600. Devices under management ~3,100 (acquired co devices not in their tooling yet).
- Win11: ~25% legacy CPM, ~0% acquired. Overall closer to 20%.
- FY26 client budget: ~$650K, "the same as last year." Covers maybe 500 devices. Acquisition did not come with an EUC budget line.

Discussion
- Zero-touch: Michelle wants Autopilot-style provisioning through Orvane Manage, drop-ship from factory to plant. Imaging bottleneck is the real constraint for acquired users.
- Brooke: Orvane Flex / DaaS - 36-month, refresh + ProCare + deployment in one monthly. Could move ~1,200 devices without a capital ask.
- Derek: out-of-warranty repair tickets up ~40% since January.

Decisions: Susan to take DaaS model to Heather Ford (COO) - CFO seat currently vacant.
Actions: Brooke - DaaS proposal for 1,200 units; Hiro - warranty roll-off report by serial; Nathan - Win11 pilot units (20) for acquired users.

author: Brooke Gutierrez
subject: DaaS proposal sent - CPM
body:
Sent Orvane Flex DaaS proposal to Susan Jackson / Heather Ford: 1,200 devices (900 Aster 5 14, 300 Cadence 3 SFF), 36 months, ProCare Plus, zero-touch deployment, trade-in credit on ~400 legacy units. Monthly fits under the $650K annual figure if phased over two years.
Heather wants to see it next to a "do nothing + extend warranty" option. No opp created yet - Madison to decide.

author: Monica Howard
subject: Warranty expirations - list attached
body:
Monica,

Pulled this from our asset system - devices whose Orvane warranty ends this year:
- Aster 5 13 G2 - 148 units (ended)
- Cadence 3 Micro G3 - 82 units (ended)
- Cadence 7 Micro G3 - 52 units (Oct)
- Aster 5 16 G3 - 50 units (Dec)
Plus about 600 devices at the acquired plants we haven't inventoried - several are 6+ years old.

We're doing out-of-warranty repairs with third-party parts at this point. Can you quote either extended warranty or replacement for the first two groups? Susan says we may have to pick one.

Derek Aguilar
Desktop Support Manager, CPM Precision Co.

author: Madison Perez
subject: Procurement turnover + portal order
body:
fyi Gregory Ortiz (procurement) left end of July and Omar Foster (VP EA) the week after. Buyer is now Mohammed Martinez. Connor Hamilton replacing Omar. Yan's SO-30182904 from May still shows PO "pending."
Closed lost 0065f00004dfCBlAAM ($180,145) today - the Northbridge laptop wave. No budget. Meanwhile last month's SO-30182921 ($83,540) was Atlas/Strata for the Northbridge site consolidation. Zero client devices. Again.

author: Hiro Gray
subject: TAM risk note - Win10 EOS / legacy fleet
body:
Win10 end of support in ~2 weeks. CPM status:
- Win11 ~25% of managed devices (unchanged since FY24). Acquired users essentially 0%.
- ~310 CPM devices out of warranty or rolling off by Dec; ~600 uninventoried at acquired sites.
- Plan of record per Susan: buy extended security updates for 1 yr, refresh "when budget allows."
- vSphere 6.7 also out of support. Backup still tape.
Recommend we escalate to exec level - this is a security exposure (97 open unpatched advisories on our gear alone) and a refresh opportunity we're not forecasting.

author: Nathan Thompson
subject: Forge order + Win11 pilot
body:
SO-30182944 ($39,623, PO 191624) - Win11 pilot devices for Northbridge users, delivered last week. Feedback good on zero-touch; Michelle got devices to plants in 2 days instead of 2 weeks.
CAM Forge upgrade - no opp yet; Susan wants to bundle it with the client refresh if that ever gets funded.
Susan: "headcount went up 65% and my budget went up zero."

author: Monica Howard
subject: No client opp in FY27
body: CPM missed again (11/10). Expect PC refresh to slip again. Also - there is no Client Devices opp open for FY27 at all. Only storage (0065f00004dfcO7AAI, $97,171) and networking (0065f00004dfaBOAAY, $41,961). Atlas AI 880 closed $463,261 last month - the AI pilot gets money, PCs don't. Brooke's DaaS proposal for 1,200 units is sitting with no opp. @Madison Perez should I create one?

author: Madison Perez
subject: Exec briefing - FY27 EUC plan
body:
Attendees: Heather Ford (COO), Connor Hamilton (VP EA), Susan Jackson; Orvane: Madison Perez, Min-jun Chavez, Ethan King (Software - Orvane Manage/Shield), Brooke Gutierrez

- Presented: 4,300 users vs ~3,100 managed devices; Win11 ~25%; ~900 devices out of warranty or Win11-ineligible incl acquired plants; ESU cost for 1 yr vs refresh.
- Heather: margin pressure, no capital for client in FY27 H1. Open to OPEX if it's "flat or better" vs current spend. Wants 3-yr view.
- Connor: acquired AD/tenant merge planned Q1 - wants devices enrolled in Orvane Manage before that.
- Susan said FY27 client budget is ~$800K (vs $650K she told us in May) - Heather didn't confirm.

Decisions: Heather OK'd a 300-device DaaS phase 1 for acquired users if monthly fits.
Actions: Brooke - re-cut DaaS at 300 + option for 900; Madison - open FY27 client devices opp; Ethan - Orvane Manage enrollment plan for tenant merge.

author: Ahmed Vargas
subject: ProCare vs refresh math
body: @Madison Perez Derek asked for extended ProCare on the 148 Aster 5 13 G2 + 82 Cadence 3 Micro G3. Quoted, but 2-yr extension on G2s is ~60% of a new device. Recommend we push those into DaaS phase 2 instead. Also - Grant Wilson left in August, Derek is your EUC ops contact.
